thesis.en: Beijing is running a calibrated, supply-and-demand 'stabilize-not-stimulate' policy mix: incremental PBoC easing (RRR + targeted rate cuts, ample liquidity) paired with fiscal support skewed to consumption trade-in (以旧换新), property stabilization and strategic industrial self-reliance (信创 / domestic semis, AI, EV, defense). The revealed priority is high-quality, self-sufficient growth and financial-risk control — not a 2009-style credit flood.
thesis.zh: 北京在执行有节制的供需双侧『稳而非刺激』政策组合：央行渐进宽松（降准＋定向降息、流动性充裕）配合偏向消费以旧换新、地产稳定与战略产业自主（信创／国产半导体、AI、新能源车、军工）的财政支持。真实优先事项是高质量、自主可控的增长与金融风险防控，而非2009式信贷洪流。

regime_read.en: Policy is easing at the margin but deliberately restrained — read incremental moves (RRR cuts, LPR trims, special-bond issuance) as risk-management of a deflationary, property-drag backdrop, not a cyclical re-acceleration bet.
regime_read.zh: 政策边际宽松但刻意克制——应将渐进举措（降准、LPR下调、专项债发行）解读为对通缩与地产拖累背景的风险管理，而非押注周期性再加速。

sector_policy.note_en: National self-reliance mandate + big-fund capital; foreign-chip substitution in gov/SOE by 2027.
sector_policy.note_zh: 国家自主可控指令＋大基金资本；2027年前政府/国企国产替代。
『东数西算』国家算力网；国产GPU（昇腾/寒武纪）推进。

sector_policy.note_en: Purchase-tax exemption extended to 2027 + trade-in subsidies; export expansion.
sector_policy.note_zh: 购置税减免延至2027＋以旧换新补贴；出口扩张。

sector_policy.note_en: Dual-carbon tailwind but acute overcapacity / price-war; policy now curbing irrational expansion.
sector_policy.note_zh: 双碳顺风但产能过剩与价格战严重；政策转向遏制非理性扩张。

sector_policy.note_en: Defense budget +7.2% (above nominal GDP); self-reliance priority.
sector_policy.note_zh: 国防预算+7.2%（高于名义GDP）；自主可控优先。

sector_policy.note_en: CSRC market-cap-management directive: raise ROE, dividends, buybacks.
sector_policy.note_zh: 证监会市值管理指引：提升ROE、分红、回购。

sector_policy.note_en: ¥300B ultra-long bonds fund appliance/car/electronics trade-in; 'expand domestic demand' priority.
sector_policy.note_zh: 3000亿超长期国债支持家电/汽车/电子以旧换新；扩内需优先。

sector_policy.note_en: Mortgage-rate + down-payment cuts, purchase-restriction relaxation, urban-village renovation — stabilize, not re-inflate.
sector_policy.note_zh: 降房贷利率与首付、放松限购、城中村改造——稳定而非再膨胀。

sector_policy.note_en: NMPA accelerated review + national biotech fund; oncology/biosimilar focus.
sector_policy.note_zh: 药监局加速审评＋国家生物科技基金；肿瘤/生物类似药聚焦。

sector_policy.note_en: CAAC + NDRC action plan 2024-2030; eVTOL / drone-logistics corridors; ¥1T-by-2030 goal.
sector_policy.note_zh: 民航局＋发改委2024-2030行动计划；eVTOL／无人机物流走廊；2030年万亿目标。

sector_policy.note_en: Crackdown normalized to predictable regulation; supported as an employment + AI engine.
sector_policy.note_zh: 整顿转为可预期的常态监管；作为就业与AI引擎获支持。

sector_policy.note_en: 双减 regime intact; for-profit K-9 tutoring still curtailed.
sector_policy.note_zh: 双减政策延续；营利性义务教育阶段培训仍受限。

sector_policy.note_en: 'Houses are for living, not speculation' frame persists alongside the stabilization push.
sector_policy.note_zh: 『房住不炒』基调与稳楼市并存。

predictions.text_en: Additional consumption trade-in / demand-side fiscal support announced in H2 2026.
predictions.text_zh: 2026下半年出台追加的消费以旧换新／需求侧财政支持。
